V1_credentials_staging_defect.severity: high (it reddens every sandboxed LIVE boot in this environment)
V1_credentials_staging_defect.mechanism: skills/dsh-qa/scripts/lib/credentials.mjs mergeRefsEntry(): the operator's ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml carries an INLINE `refs: {}` (3 characters after the colon, measured; key names only, no values read). The existing-refs regex `/^refs:[ \t]*$/m` does not match it, the flat-layout branch is skipped (the document has `version:`), so the function falls through and APPENDS a second top-level `refs:` key. The harness's strict YAML reader rejects it as DUPLICATE_KEY, the credentials row fails, and the whole plugin tree fails to load.
V1_credentials_staging_defect.demonstration: credentials-merge-repro.mjs (SECRET-FREE, synthetic document): inline `refs: {}` -> 2 top-level refs keys; control bare `refs:` -> 1. Exit 0 (assertion held).

Both live-boot reds (AC12 real run, test:qa's dispatch case) share this one cause.
remedy_options: fix mergeRefsEntry to treat an inline `refs: {}`/`refs: <map>` as a mergeable refs block (or to replace it)
or make the staging copy normalize the document before writing it into the sandbox
